scenario.summary: The NIK C2 framework is a Go-based Windows implant that leverages integrated AI models to analyze harvested data in real-time. The campaign involves credential dumping, keystroke streaming, and the deployment of screen-locking ransomware, while masking infrastructure by hijacking victims' OpenAI API keys for data processing.

meta.rationale: Target Windows hosts, especially those belonging to users with access to sensitive credentials or cloud development environments (likely to hold API keys). Focus on the last 14 days following the Talos advisory.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder has deployed the NIK C2 implant to harvest browser credentials and crypto wallets, potentially preparing to deploy screen-locking ransomware.

hunt.name: AI-Driven NIK C2 Implant and Data Theft
hunt.description: The NIK C2 framework employs a Go-based Windows implant that integrates AI to analyze stolen data in real-time. This adversary hijacks victim API keys to fund AI requests and deploys screen-locking ransomware to finish the operation. The hunt first identifies known malicious filenames or hashes from Talos telemetry. If a lead is confirmed, the hunt fans out to examine behavioral indicators of credential harvesting targeting browser databases and crypto wallets. Finally, the analyst evaluates file activity for rapid encryption or renaming patterns typical of ransomware impact.

nodes.label: Search for NIK C2 and associated malware

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, process_hash_sha256, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{implant_hashes}}' || ',', ',' || process_hash_sha256 || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{implant_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify processes by known malicious hashes or specific filenames used by the NIK C2 framework.
config.expected_signal: A row indicates a known malicious process is active on a host. Zero rows suggests this specific implant version is not currently running.

config.objective: Determine if any host shows evidence of NIK C2 or related malicious execution based on the process metadata.
config.description: Evaluate if the processes found in the lead query are legitimate administrative tools or confirmed malware based on their execution context.
config.expected_signal: A verdict on whether the lead is worth full investigation.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict of suspicious or malicious.

config.question: the gate-agent verdict is suspicious or malicious for any host
config.condition: the gate-agent verdict is suspicious or malicious for any host
config.description: Open the expensive behavioral queries only if the lead results indicate suspicious activity.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_path, activity_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\google\chrome\user data\default\login data%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\wallets\%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\.wallet%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find non-browser processes accessing sensitive browser database files or crypto wallet directories on the flagged hosts.
config.expected_signal: A non-browser process reading these paths is a high-confidence indicator of data theft.

primitive_config.expected: A non-browser process reading these paths is a high-confidence indicator of data theft.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(*) as file_count, MIN(time) as first_impact, MAX(time) as last_impact FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (activity_id = 1 OR activity_id = 5) AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.locked' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.enc' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.nik') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name
config.description: Identify processes that rapidly rename or create files with extensions used by the NIK C2 framework ransomware component.
config.expected_signal: A process that creates or renames many files with suspicious extensions confirms an active encryption event. Zero rows means no ransomware impact occurred on these hosts during the window.

primitive_config.expected: A process that creates or renames many files with suspicious extensions confirms an active encryption event. Zero rows means no ransomware impact occurred on these hosts during the window.

config.objective: Assess the combined evidence from all queries to confirm the NIK C2 attack chain and its impact on each host.
